visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A sleek black cat rests its head on a soft, cream-colored cushion with a yellow border and textured fabric. Around its neck is a white padded cone collar decorated with small green rabbit-head patterns. The background is a cluttered indoor office environment featuring computer monitors and papers. A white text overlay in traditional Chinese appears prominently in the center. (2) A human hand enters the frame from the left and gently scratches the top of the cat's head. The cat's eyes squint and then fully close, signaling relaxation. The camera holds a tight close-up on the cat's face, blurring the messy background items. Brackets containing text appear to represent the scratching action. (3) The hand moves to scratch the cat's chin, causing its head to tilt slightly upward. The cat's mouth opens slightly, and its facial expression suggests deep satisfaction. The lighting is bright and even, likely from indoor office lights. More bracketed text appears on the screen to match the physical gesture. (4) The hand stops scratching and leaves the frame. The cat immediately opens its yellow-green eyes and stares directly at the lens. It then opens its mouth wide in a large yawn or demanding meow, showing its tongue and teeth. Large white subtitles change to reflect the cat's vocal demand. (5) The cat meows again in an extreme close-up, looking quite insistent. The hand returns to scratch the cat's chin and head once more. The cat settles back into the cushion, closing its eyes as it enjoys the physical contact. The visual rhythm is fast with frequent cuts between these close-up moments. (6) The video cuts to a final screen with a solid pink background. White text featuring both traditional Chinese characters and English text displays the brand logo in a clean, centered layout. The frame is completely static and lacks any physical objects or characters.
